title: VarTrace coverage variant (stable / permuted x covered / uncovered) at four scales and both sources
status: registered before any run of this extension; see REGISTRATION_4SCALE.json for the timestamp and SHA256
request: User task list of 2026-11-21, item 5: existing VT3 is VarTrace 130M, Muon source only, three data worlds. Add the 130M AdamW source, and both sources at 300M, 520M and 1.2B.
existing_version: DESIGN.md of the v3 coverage study (2026-10-26); results VT3_RESULTS.json. Everything not named under 'what_changes' is that protocol.

scope.per_scale_and_source: 2 optimizers x 4 regimes (anchor_cov, perm_cov, anchor_unc, perm_unc; anchor = stable names, perm = permuted names, cov / unc = G2 slot-name pairs covered / not covered in training) x 3 worlds = 24 runs

protocol_identical_to_130m_M_source.data: the frozen v3 data (three worlds x four regimes); they do not depend on the model
protocol_identical_to_130m_M_source.blocks: world w uses schedule rotation w, order seed 20261022 (three worlds = three blocks)
protocol_identical_to_130m_M_source.training: 682 steps x 64, frozen trainer, auxiliary AdamW learning rate 3e-5, weight decay 0, gradient clipping 1.0, tf32
protocol_identical_to_130m_M_source.evaluation: steps 20, 30, 45, 70, 100, 150, 220, 320, 460, 682; probes M, G1, G2, SW, CF at every step, S at the final step; valid-derivation scoring
protocol_identical_to_130m_M_source.launch_order: the cov block (worlds 0-2) before the unc block

what_changes.base_models: adamw_<scale>_4 / muon_<scale>_4 of each new cell

learning_rates.rule: the VarTrace main-experiment learning rates of that scale and source, not re-selected (the 130M rule)

primary_quantities.outcome: G2 valid-derivation accuracy at the final step
primary_quantities.scale_of_analysis: per world, G2 items pooled over the 16 families; Delta_r,w = logit(Muon) - logit(AdamW) with +0.5; Delta_r = mean over worlds; the percentage-point family-macro difference is reported alongside (G2_pp_final_valid)
primary_quantities.intervals: 2000 draws (seed 20261026) resampling families within each world, the same draw for all regimes and both optimizers; and the hierarchical bootstrap (worlds, then families) reported as ci95_hier
primary_quantities.reading: predictability effect if I_P < 0, the interval excludes 0 and I_P < 0 in each world; no predictability effect if the interval of I_P lies inside (-0.29, +0.29); otherwise inconclusive. AUC over log-step and G2 at matched M gold NLL (0.01) are reported and read separately.

outputs.result_file: VT3_RESULTS.json with the existing structure (G2_pp_final_valid and the other blocks with ci95_hier; I_P, I_C, PxC; log-odds versions and the equivalence-interval reading); keys prefixed with '<scale>/<source>'
outputs.package: MuonPaperData_<date>_VT3_<scale>.zip: result JSON, per-checkpoint tables, training curves, learning rates used, analysis scripts, this file, SHA256 list. No user, institution or host name in paths or contents.

execution.host_classes: 130m A source: h200 / h100 (as the existing 130M runs); 300m, 520m, 1.2b: a100. A pair of AdamW and Muon cells always runs on one host class.
execution.weights: final-step weights are kept until the dW spectra are computed and world 0 is exported
